selection: All 360 frozen native roots, both sides: 720 greedy decisions. No root selection by candidate outcomes.
candidate: Cap raw conditional mean damage at current target HP before applying hit probability. Break capped-score ties by the original raw score. Change only positive-scoring ordinary greedy picks; preserve Perish overrides, all-zero choices and last-mon self-KO exclusions. No production modification.
analysis: Join the frozen engine-enumerated first-step cells. Report changed decisions and exact terminal-score intervals against every reply, keeping unresolved mass [0,1]. Compare candidate and baseline pure security intervals; do not infer long-term gain from immediate KO alone. No tuning after this screen.
scope: Known native battle states and an approximate proposed rollout ranking. The engine outcome checks, not the capped estimate, provide certificates. Not blind-policy or whole-game strength proof.
